item.text: I’ll read the three files once, then make one algorithm-level improvement in `algorithm.py` using a native patch.

The current proposal adjusts only one object’s x coordinate, then clamps it, which can undo the preferred distance. It also ignores height differences, although the contract specifies 3D centre distances. I’ll add bounded refinement that preserves seeded yaws and footprint bounds, accepting moves only when analytic preference error decreases without increasing relation-limit error. Mesh and diversity effects remain unmeasured.

Modified only `algorithm.py` to add bounded 3D distance refinement. It preserves seeded yaws and footprint bounds while accepting only analytic preference improvements that do not increase relation-limit error.

Tests were left to the external controller; Mesh and diversity gains remain unverified.
